headline: How Google Outsmarted Apple in Europe's AI War
reasoning: This topic scores highly due to its strong clickability, pitting tech giants Apple and Google against each other in a high-stakes regulatory battle over AI. It has massive mainstream appeal by explaining why a major new feature is available on one platform but not another for millions of users. The story also lends itself perfectly to multiple engaging formats, such as a head-to-head comparison or a hot-take opinion piece, making it a prime candidate for our publication.
summary: The EU has granted Google a grace period to make Android compliant for rival AI assistants, while denying Apple a similar runway for its new Siri AI. This has allowed Google's Gemini to stay on the market in Europe while Apple has withheld its new AI features, highlighting a major strategic divergence.

source_articles.title: Google is better at playing the EU regulations game
source_articles.excerpt: Today, the European Union ordered Google to give its AI rivals greater access to Android, the open-source operating system that powers billions of devices worldwide.
